tools.name: get_site_info
tools.description: What Bike4Mind is, in machine-readable form: the open-core AI workbench (notebooks, agents, 13 artifact types, image gen, data lakes, MCP host+server), licensing (BSL 1.1 → Apache-2.0 ratchet), deployment modes, and every agent-facing surface this site publishes.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: The live Bike4Mind model catalog — synced from the live Bike4Mind models API (the same models the app offers). Filter by type ('text'|'image'), provider, or a substring query. Returns name, provider, context window, max output, cost tier (text models), and a per-entry source for auditing.

provider.description: e.g. Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, xAI, Amazon Bedrock, Black Forest Labs

tools.name: get_comparison
tools.description: The full Bike4Mind vs ChatGPT (OpenAI) vs Claude (Anthropic) vs Microsoft Copilot vs build-it-yourself comparison — the same table rendered at /compare, with the structural argument: a lab can't be model-neutral, a cloud can't be cloud-neutral.

tools.name: get_open_core_facts
tools.description: The open-core licensing and sovereignty facts: the BSL 1.1 → Apache-2.0 ratchet, the three-ring 'door out' (Usage Policy §0), and why the exit is the trust.

tools.name: search_blog_posts
tools.description: Search bike4mind.com blog posts. Multi-word queries are matched term by term across title, tags, summary and full body — so natural phrasing works ("open core licensing") and you do not have to guess a post's exact wording. Results are ranked: posts matching every term come first, partial matches follow rather than being discarded. Omit q to list the most recent posts. Returns compact listings with URLs.

q.description: words to search for, in any order; matched across title, tags, summary and body

tools.name: get_blog_post
tools.description: Fetch a bike4mind.com blog post's full content by slug.

tools.name: whats_new
tools.description: Dated product updates from Bike4Mind and its products (Paintbox, Tarot, Stocks and Vibes, Bedrock News, K2 Kanji, Manifold, Fleet, Overwatch, Bob), newest first. Each entry is one sentence with a kind (feature, art or fix), a product tag, and any screenshots or demo videos as absolute media URLs. Filter by product slug and/or a start date; omit both for the latest updates.

product.description: product slug, one of: bike4mind, paintbox, tarot, stocks-and-vibes, bedrock-news, k2kanji, manifold, fleet, overwatch, bob, 4xciv, one-more-road

since.description: only entries on or after this day, YYYY-MM-DD

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: Every product in the Bike4Mind ecosystem (Bike4Mind itself, Bedrock News, K2Kanji, Stocks and Vibes, Bob, 4XCiv, Paintbox, Overwatch, Tarot, Manifold, Fleet) plus Friends of Bike4Mind, products other people built with it (tier 'friend', with a creator): name, one-line tagline, status (live, beta or in development), category, public URL where there is one, and the bike4mind.com page for each. Filter by category or status.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: One product in the Bike4Mind ecosystem by slug: what it is, where Bike4Mind fits in it, status, category, links, and its latest dated updates.

slug.description: product slug, one of: bike4mind, bedrock-news, k2kanji, stocks-and-vibes, bob, 4xciv, paintbox, overwatch, tarot, manifold, fleet, one-more-road
